package.description: Record multiple screens at once, combined into a single video.

en-US.description: Record multiple screens at once, combined into a single video.
en-US.longDescription:
Lightweight desktop screen recorder for Windows built with Tauri 2.
Records up to 4 screens or windows simultaneously into a single video with
an automatic grid layout, live previews, microphone and system audio,
webcam overlay, auto-stop timer, standard output resolution caps
(720p to 8K) and one-click H.264 MP4 export via bundled FFmpeg.
en-US.name: Multi Screen Recorder
